title: Where should your agents work?
intro: Your agents can work in a folder on this Mac, or on a computer in the cloud. You can add the other kind later.
movesHome: Work on this Mac moves Home and makes this Mac your primary computer. Your cloud computer stays, and steps in while the Mac is asleep.
movesHomeFromMachine: Work on this Mac moves Home here from {{name}} and makes this Mac your primary computer. {{name}} stays one of your computers.
saveFailed: Couldn't save your answer. Try again.
checkFailed: Couldn't check this Mac with the server. Try again, or continue without setting it up.
setupHelper: Your agents will work in a folder on this Mac. LangAlpha asks you to confirm in a window of its own, and macOS may ask you to allow it in the background.
backupNotice: With backup on, a copy of each workspace's files is kept on the server, so you can open them while this Mac is away and restore a lost folder. Home lives on your primary computer, so that computer needs backup on.
backupOffCloud: Without backup, this Mac can't be your primary computer, so Home stays on the cloud.
backupOffMachine: Without backup, this Mac can't be your primary computer, so Home stays on {{name}}.
backupOffNew: Without backup, this Mac can't be your primary computer, so Home and new workspaces go on a cloud computer.
donePrimary: Home and new workspaces go on this Mac.
doneMoving: Home is moving to this Mac. Your cloud computer stays, and steps in while the Mac is asleep.
doneMovingFromMachine: Home is moving to this Mac from {{name}}.
doneNotPrimaryCloud: This Mac is one of your computers now. Without backup it can't be your primary computer, so Home stays on the cloud.
doneNotPrimaryMachine: This Mac is one of your computers now. Without backup it can't be your primary computer, so Home stays on {{name}}.
doneNotPrimaryNew: This Mac is one of your computers now. Without backup it can't be your primary computer, so Home and new workspaces go on a cloud computer.
